title: Blob Royale protocol v3 world snapshot data
description: One complete immutable simulation tick: per-stream random draw counts, every published entity in ascending entity_id order with the components it carries, and the generic match section. Never a delta, never partial.

random_draw_counts.description: Committed cumulative draw counts in the closed random-stream registry order. Counts expose neither seeds nor generator state.
random_draw_counts.$comment: Each engine count is uint64; the encoder rejects a count above 2^53-1 with stream-specific context rather than rounding or clamping. Initialization consumes neither stream. The old C++ scalar random_draw_count was never a v3 JSON member.

entities.$comment: Every published entity counts against this bound, including map static bodies and the zone entity. Ascending unique entity_id is a normative invariant that JSON Schema cannot express; docs/protocol/v3.md owns it and C++ conformance tests assert it.
